activities.name: Refactor linter to use segmenter
activities.description: The current verify_markdown() uses regex on raw markdown. Refactor to use the segmenter pipeline (parse → segment → lint rules) so the linter operates on EmailStructure objects, not raw text. This also fixes the button syntax inconsistency: verify_markdown() detects {{button ...}} but the segmenter uses {.button} via attrs_plugin.
acceptance: verify_markdown() uses segmenter to build EmailStructure objects
Lint rules operate on EmailStructure, not raw regex
Button detection uses the same syntax as the segmenter ({.button})
tasks: Refactor verify_markdown() to use MarkdownItParser + segment()
Update lint rules to work on EmailStructure objects
Fix button syntax detection to match segmenter ({.button})

activities.name: Add configurer and warnings to markdown_to_email
activities.description: markdown_to_email() currently returns empty meta and warnings. Add a configurer service to parse frontmatter and resolve themes, and integrate the linter to collect warnings during render.
acceptance: markdown_to_email() parses YAML frontmatter into meta dict
Theme resolution works with frontmatter config
Linter warnings are collected in result['warnings']
result['meta'] contains parsed frontmatter (subject, preheader, etc.)
tasks: Create configurer service (frontmatter parsing + theme resolution)
Integrate linter into markdown_to_email() for warnings
Return proper meta and warnings in result dict

activities.name: Migrate CLI from argparse to typer
activities.description: The CLI currently uses argparse but pyproject.toml defines typer as the cli optional dependency. Migrate to typer and fix the render output behavior (currently outputs HTML only, not both HTML+text as docs describe).
acceptance: CLI uses typer instead of argparse
typer is properly declared as cli optional dependency
render outputs HTML by default, --text for text/plain
CLI help text is clear and accurate

Update CLI help text to match actual behavior
